description: BusinessObjects universe whose physical names do NOT match the warehouse — the customer restructured into a platinum layer (FCT_ORDERS_RAW→ORDER_FACT, CUST_DIM_DE→CUSTOMER_DIM, and renamed columns). Exercises the target-layer remap (tableMap/columnMap on convert_bobj_to_sigma): without it every column would resolve to a non-existent table. Regression guard that the remapped output binds to real CSA.TJ tables and that the cross-element relationship + View still resolve with zero error columns.
